post.title: Wealthfront is a robo-advisor. 74% of FY2026 revenue was cash
post.ig:
Wealthfront is a robo-advisor, but in fiscal 2026, 74% of its revenue came from cash.

Year ended Jan 31, 2026: $271.7M from cash management vs $91.9M from investment advisory, of $365.0M total. In the quarter ended July 31, 2026, cash was about 67% of revenue, and Wealthfront's cash fee rate was about 0.55% a year (down from about 0.61% a year earlier); the advisory fee is 0.25%. On a hypothetical $10,000: about $55 kept on cash vs $25 for investing, per year.
In 2022, Schwab paid $187M to settle SEC charges over cash in its no-fee robo (no admission).

Sources: Wealthfront FY2026 results (Mar 2026), Q2 FY2027 results (Sep 2026), S-1 (2025); SEC (June 2022).
News and education, not financial advice.
